_comment: P-TQA.7 — accepted/pre-existing high+critical advisories. The audit gate (scripts/auditGate.mjs) BLOCKS any high/critical NOT listed here. Each entry is triaged: dev-only, no safe fix, or a separate upgrade task. Re-triage periodically and remove once fixed. A NEW high/critical in any other package fails CI.

allow.reason: dev-only test runner (not shipped to users); fix requires a major-version bump tracked as a separate task.
dev-only coverage tool (P-TQA.1); same advisory as vitest (via: vitest) — fix is a semver-major vitest 4 upgrade tracked with the vitest entry. Never shipped to users.
dev/build-only toolchain (not shipped at runtime); upgrade tracked separately to avoid a risky major bump.
pre-existing transitive; upgrade evaluated separately (used server-side; needs regression check before bumping).
payments SDK; vendor-pinned — upgrade requires payment-flow re-verification, tracked separately.
no upstream fix available on npm (prototype-pollution/ReDoS advisories); usage is server-side and input-controlled — tracked separately.

advisory GHSA (React Router RSC Mode CSRF Bypass) affects vulnerable range 7.12.0-8.2.0; the latest published version (7.18.1) is still in-range and npm's only 'fix' is a BREAKING downgrade to 7.11.0, so no safe forward fix exists yet. The vulnerable code path is RSC/framework mode — NavBharatAI uses react-router-dom purely as a client-side SPA (BrowserRouter/createBrowserRouter; NO @react-router/dev|node|serve framework packages), so RSC actions are never executed. Re-triage + upgrade when a patched version >8.2.0 ships.

flagged via react-router (same RSC-mode CSRF advisory). SPA-only usage; not exploitable without RSC/framework mode, which this app does not use. Bumped to the latest 7.18.1; upgrade tracked with the react-router entry.
